An incentive of 0.5% reduction in energy charges component of electricity bill is provided for every 0.01 increase in power factor over and above 0.95. The average energy charge component of the electricity bill per month for the plant is Rs. 20 lakhs. The plant decides to increase the power factor to unity by installing capacitor banks.
